method: factory/tools/mutation-calibration/calibrate.py: each mutation edits a copy of run 01 of real committed/rerun evidence; the verdict is the exit status of `pair.py <case> --recompare <run>` (same gate dispatch as the pipeline)

pixel.gates: exact, edge-aa<=32 band (decision 5), hazeTolerance 3 (D9), named exclusions (decision 2), capture size, half-pixel tie cases (blocks-6-10/pixel-ties)

text.gates: glyph-region ink bbox within 1 px, exact outside the region (decision 2, block 4)

text-colour.gates: strongest ink colour within 24/255 per channel (decisions 2, 10, 11; A1; D1)

button.gates: push Button height/y, caps, flat bands, label centre and ink (decision 11; A1-A3)

control.gates: labelled Toggle control size/y/edges, label centre (1 px), row leading x, label first ink x, label-to-control gap (decisions 7, 8, 16)

list.gates: List rows, text, order, selection, frames within 1 px, label ink (A6-A9)

semantic.gates: UIA vs AX: role, name, value, toggle, enabled, dialogs, order, count, static default button from the host log (F3; B4-B6, D4-D7, A4; decision 17)

ime.gates: IME marked range, selected range and composed text per step, Windows HOST_FIELD log vs Mac MAC_FACT log (decision 15)

clock.gates: F1 manual clock: extent, leading and trailing edge position (C2 1 px; spring 2 px; decision 18), pixels outside strips, progress (C1-C10)

text-origin.gates: TextField first ink x and y, baseline, selection colour and start, caret (decisions 12, 13, 14)

multi-run.gates: the case verdict is every run passing: one bad run of three must fail

notCalibratedOffline.why: needs Windows hardware; the Sandbox drives IME in-process (decisions B6, D8). Only the comparators on those dumps are calibrated.

notCalibratedOffline.what: UIA keyboard focus and OS-level focus restore
notCalibratedOffline.why: UIA reports no keyboard focus in the Sandbox (decision D7), so the gates never read it; nothing to calibrate offline.

notCalibratedOffline.what: The capture hosts themselves (Windows renderer paint, Mac NSHostingView / AXDump / AlertHooks / MAC_FACT writers)
notCalibratedOffline.why: they produce the evidence the comparators read; checking them needs new captures, which this pass excludes. Mutations assume the recorded Mac side is the truth.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Case-level options no shipped case exercises (the full "bounds" semantic field with boundsTolerancePt, a non-zero firstInkTolerancePx or selectionStartTolerancePx, the dark/pressed/focused button states, scales 1.25 and 1.5)
notCalibratedOffline.why: there is no real run evidence to mutate; unit tests in factory/tools/test_pair_*.py cover bounds, default button and tolerance on synthetic dumps only.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Runtime unit suites (Swift: runtime 333, host 121, bridge 51) and the consolidation driver (factory/pipeline/consolidation/run_all.py)
notCalibratedOffline.why: they are not run-evidence comparators; the driver records pair.py's exit status, which the harness does exercise.

the Windows host's request to the TaskDialog (HOST_DIALOG_REQUEST default=N in the host log), not an observation of the dialog: UIA cannot show it (D7). That the TaskDialog honours the request is the Enter case's behaviour check (default-enter-v1), and a host log that lies about its own request is not mutated beyond the edits listed.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Non-ASCII composed text in the IME gate (decision 15)
notCalibratedOffline.why: the Windows host log is written in the console code page, so only the ASCII prefix and the presence of a continuation are compared from the logs; the exact characters are compared on the final frame by the semantic gate from UIA values, and the intermediate non-ASCII steps are not compared character by character.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Leading-edge tolerance of the clock gate (decision 18)
notCalibratedOffline.why: the leading edge measured 0.000 px on every committed clock run but is gated at the named 1 px (springs 2 px), so a 1 px translation of a 1 px case and a 2 px translation of a spring case pass by design.

notCalibratedOffline.what: Provenance gates (stage identity in build.json, renderer sha256, receipts)
notCalibratedOffline.why: the lean loop (decision 4) records them but no comparator reads them; earlier provenance fault controls live in factory/pipeline/paired-five-seeded-observations-actual-v4/fault-controls.json.
